title: From Comparison to Selection: Enhancing Cross-Scale Generalization of Pointer Networks Trained with Reinforcement Learning for Capacitated Drone Delivery Routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.27936v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) enable fast, flexible last-mile and emergency delivery, but their routing remains challenging as the number of clients varies. Classical approaches based on mixed-integer programming and heuristics can scale poorly or require problem-specific design, motivating learning-based alternatives. Reinforcement learning is particularly promising, provided a single policy can generalize across problem sizes without retraining. Although attention-based Pointer Networks are inherently size-agnostic, their solution quality degrades under both upscaling and downscaling. Using the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) as a controlled proxy, with fixed capacity reflecting drone payload constraints, we investigate this degradation and identify three contributing factors: shifts in node density, attention dispersion, and dilution of the mean-pooled graph context. translated_abstract: 无人机（UAV）能够实现快速、灵活的最后一公里配送和应急配送，但随着客户数量的变化，其路径规划仍然具有挑战性。基于混合整数规划和启发式算法的经典方法扩展性较差，或需要针对特定问题的设计，这促使人们探索基于学习的替代方案。强化学习尤其具有前景，前提是单一策略无需重新训练即可在不同问题规模上进行泛化。尽管基于注意力的指针网络本质上具有规模无关性，但其求解质量在规模扩大和缩小两种情况下均会出现退化。我们以带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP）作为受控代理模型（其固定容量反映了无人机载荷约束），对这种退化现象进行了研究，并识别出三个影响因素：节点密度的变化、注意力的分散，以及均值池化图上下文的稀释。我们系统地比较了……
tldr: 该论文利用带容量约束的车辆路径问题作为无人机配送路径规划的受控代理模型，研究了强化学习训练的注意力指针网络在不同问题规模下泛化时的性能退化现象，识别出节点密度变化、注意力分散和均值池化上下文稀释三个成因，并提出了从比较到选择的新方法以增强跨尺度泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates the cross-scale generalization degradation of reinforcement learning-trained attention Pointer Networks for capacitated drone delivery routing, using CVRP as a controlled proxy to identify node density shifts, attention dispersion, and mean-pooled context dilution as key causes, and proposes a shift from comparison to selection to enhance generalization across problem scales.
